 JUDGMENT
The petitioner have filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, claiming compensation of Rs.30,00,000/- for the death of Smt.Ganga W/o Boja in a road traffic accident.

The brief facts of the petitioner' case are as under:
2. That on 11-02-2021 at about 06-05 a.m. when the deceased Smt.Ganga, was standing to cross the road, near Lumax Company, Bidadi Industrial Area, Bidadi,
Ramanagara District, at that time the driver of Truck bearing registration No. NL- 01-Q-4502 came from very rash and negligent manner and hit the deceased.
As a result deceased fell down to the road, at the mean time the driver of the Bus bearing registration No.KA-51-C-9971 came in a rash and negligent manner and the bus ran over the deceased.
As a result of which, the deceased sustained grievous injuries and died at the spot.
Thereafter post mortem was conducted at Rajarajeshwari Hospital.
Subsequently, the petitioner has spent Rs.1,00,000/- towards transportation of dead body, funeral, obsequies ceremonies and other incidental expenses.
3. It is further stated that prior to the accident, the deceased was working in Lumax company and was earning Rs.15,000/- per month and contributing entire income towards the welfare of the family.

Due to untimely death of the deceased, life of the petitioner become dark, causing lot of pain,
shock and mental agony.

Bidadi Police have registered the case against the drivers of said vehicles in Crime No.50/2021.

sentences.text: It was observed that, "While determining the income, an addition of 50 per cent of actual salary to the income of the deceased towards future prospects, where the deceased had a permanent job and was below the age of 40 years, should be made.
The addition should be 30 per cent, if the age of the deceased was between 40 and 50 years.
In case the deceased was between the age of 50 and 60 years, the addition should be 15 per cent.
Actual salary should be read as actual salary less tax.
In case the deceased was self-employed or on a fixed salary, an addition of 40 per cent of the established income should be the warrant where the deceased was below the age of 40 year.
An addition of 25 per cent where the deceased was between the age of 40 to 50 years.

An addition of 25 per cent where the deceased was between the age of 40 and 50 years and 10 per cent where the deceased was between the age of 50-60 years should be regarded as the necessary method of computation.
The established income means the income minus the tax component. "

36. Having considered the above as per law laid down in the above case, in connection with the deduction of personal and living expenses is concerned, it is settled that, "where the deceased was married, the deduction towards personal and living expenses of the deceased should be one third (1/3rd) where the number of dependent family members is 2 to 3, 1/4th where the number of dependent family member is 4 to 6 and one fifth (1/5th ) where the number of the dependant family members exceeds six."
In the light of the above proposition, in the case on hand, 50% has to be deducted towards personal and living expenses out of the total compensation.

In the present case,
deceased was aged about 33 years, as on the date of the accident.

LIABILITY:
42.

As regards the liability is concerned, as already discussed in issue No.1 that, the accident occurred due to the actionable negligence on the part of the driver of the bus bearing No.KA-51-C-9971 and driver of the truck bearing No.NL-01-Q-4502.
Therefore, respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation to the petitioner.
43. Further as per Ex.R2 insurance policy of the Bus bearing No.KA-51-C-9971 was valid from 14.01.2021 to 13.01.2022
As per Ex.R9 the insurance policy of truck bearing No.NL-01-Q-4502 was valid from 08.11.2020 to 07.11.2021.
The alleged accident had taken place on 11.02.2021.
As such, I am of the view that, the respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation.

In view of the valid insurance policy of the bus and truck, the respondent No.2 & 4 are liable to pay the compensation at the ratio of 50% each with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition, till its realization.
Accordingly, I am answering the issue No.2 Partly in the Affirmative.
